sources.title: [Patch 26.3] Hof's high-elo Singed guide - Runes/Masteries/Matchups - How to troll (effectively)

passive.name: Noxious Slipstream
passive.text: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

spells.name: Poison Trail
spells.text: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

spells.name: Mega Adhesive
spells.text: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.

spells.name: Fling
spells.text: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

spells.name: Insanity Potion
spells.text: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

damage.value: Singed uses poison and favors a full AP build for maximum damage.

winCondition.value: Singed creates space by ganking, roaming, and disrupting the enemy jungler.

spikes.why: Singed gains increased combat stats, and his Poison Trail applies Grievous Wounds.

bait.why: After Singed throws Mega Adhesive, its 17–13 second cooldown leaves him without its slow and grounding effect.
After Singed uses Fling, its 10–8 second cooldown leaves him unable to fling another target.
After Singed uses Insanity Potion, its 100-second cooldown leaves him without its increased combat stats once the effect ends.

mistakes.value: Singed players should not assume an unconventional map position is always a mistake, because it can be the correct play for Singed.
